first.rationale: Onboarding completion is currently down, and two inherited findings indicate that reducing friction improved completion, activation, and early adoption. I would verify both records to confirm intervention details, segment applicability, durability, and any evidence of downstream qualified revenue. This is preferable to reacting immediately with discounts, whose long-term cohort quality and retention effects are not established in the summarized memory. The experiment should measure qualified pipeline or retained revenue alongside completion and activation.
